data.gender_notes: Ephram is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Ephram is recorded in name-lists as “Double fruitful”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ephram total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

biblical_reference.verse_reference: Genesis 30:23, 41:52, 1Chronicles 1:26, 2Chronicles 2:3, 2Chronicles 11:18, Joshua 24:32, Isaiah 7:14, Hosea 5:13, Hosea 10:6, Hosea 12:1, Joel 3:16
biblical_reference.note: The name Ephram is derived from the Hebrew word פרעם (pārām), which means 'fruitful' or 'large fruit'. In the Old Testament, Ephraim is the second son of Joseph and Asenath, and one of the twelve tribes of Israel. Ephraim is also used as a synonym for the northern kingdom of Israel.
